title.narrative: UN Women Colombia 2018-2023 - UN Women Colombia 2018-2023 NS

description.narrative:
The objectives of the intervention did not change, but they were updated based on the New Strategic Note for UN Women 2021-2024 approved in October 2021. The main objective is "to contribute to the efforts carried out by Colombia to face the challenges and opportunities identified, mainly gender inequalities, to strengthen the empowerment of women and girls, their participation in the consolidation and stabilization in the territories and to guarantee their right to have a life free of violence".
The new structure of the Strategic Note differs from the previous one, based on the government's request to align it to the UN Cooperation Framework (UNSSCDF), but there are no substantial changes. All previous components and working lines are included in the following three areas:
1) Stabilization: Peace with Legality;
2) Migration as a development factor; and
3) Technical assistance for the acceleration of catalyst Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
Sweden's support is aligned with Areas 1 and 3 where peace issues and political and economic empowerment activities are included.

The overall objective of this unearmarked support to UN Women in Colombia is to contribute to strengthen the political and economic empowerment of women and their right to a life free from violence, both in the context of the conflict as well as beyond it, in a way that supports the construction of stable and sustainable peace. To achieve this, UN Women focuses on reaching the following results:
1) Increasing women’s leadership and participation in decision-making at all levels. 2) Economically empowering women, particularly the poorest and most excluded. 3) Guaranteeing a life free of violence for women and girls. 4) Shaping peace and security, and humanitarian action through female leadership and participation.
The support is a continuation of two previous phases with ID-numbers: 61000962 and 52060066.

UN Women:s kontor i Colombia har överlämnat ett förslag till Sveriges Ambassad i Bogotá om finansiering på 49 MSEK för att stödja implementeringen av det Landspecifika Strategiska Dokumentet i Colombia (Strategic Note Colombia) under perioden den 1 juni 2018 – 31 december 2021.
Det övergripande syftet med insatsen är att stärka den politiska och ekonomiska egenmakten av kvinnor och deras rätt till ett liv fritt från våld, både i kontexten av konflikt likväl som bortom detta, på ett sätt som stödjer byggandet av en varaktig och hållbar fred. I avsikt att uppnå detta, kommer UN Women under denna period att fokusera på följande områden: 1) Kvinnor leder och medverkar i beslutstagande på alla nivåer; 2) Kvinnor, särskilt de fattigaste och mest exkluderade, åstadkommer ekonomisk egenmakt genom och med fördel av utveckling; 3) Kvinnor och flickor lever ett liv fritt från våld; 4) Fred och säkerhet, och humanitära aktioner är formade av kvinnligt ledarskap och deltagande.
